meta.name: SWARM
meta.note: Single source of truth for every number shown on the site. Edit here, then mirror the same values in the static HTML fallbacks (see README.md).

status.ribbon: Mainnet in preparation · the public testnet is live — test coins have no value.
status.detail: SWARM's mainnet has not launched. The public testnet has run the final economic rules since 2026-09-21; test coins have no monetary value and do not carry over. There is no sale, no token offering and no launch date.
status.flipNote: When mainnet launches: set phase to 'mainnet', update ribbon/badge/footer text in index.html, tools/build_pages.py and support/index.html, add mainnet entries to data/downloads.json, and copy the mainnet genesis block into the genesis object below.

chain.lineage: Forked from open-source Zcash software (Zebra full node, Zaino indexer, Zingo desktop wallet) with consensus rules and cryptography left unmodified.

genesis.note: Copied from network/swarm-testnet/manifest.json, the published network definition. tools/build_pages.py renders the Genesis rules block on /network from here, so no address or hash is typed into HTML by hand. The baseline-miner payout address is operational, not consensus, and is deliberately not listed.
genesis.custody: On this testnet each script is controlled by a single key held by the project. How keys are generated, held and used will be written down and published before mainnet launches.

rewardSplit.label: Fixed in the genesis rules for the whole emission schedule. Paid block by block as part of each block reward — not a premine.
rewardSplit.appliesFor: The whole emission schedule. Every halving reduces all four amounts proportionally, keeping the same 80 / 8 / 4 / 8 structure, until block rewards reach zero.
rewardSplit.destinations: Each allocation is paid automatically to its predefined destination address. Destinations can only be changed through a formal protocol upgrade; the percentages themselves cannot be changed.

shares.name: Miner
shares.desc: Paid to the forager who found the block.

shares.name: Core Development
shares.desc: Funds work on the node, indexer and wallet.

shares.name: Grants & Ecosystem
shares.desc: Funds tooling, documentation and community work.

shares.name: Community & Development Reserve
shares.desc: Set aside for the community and for future development. How it is governed and spent will be defined separately and published before mainnet launches.

lifetimeTotals.note: Amounts are exact to the smallest unit for the first seven eras (about 28 years). After that the inherited rounding rule rounds each allocation down to a whole unit and the miner receives the remainder, which is why the lifetime miner share is fractionally above 80%.

emission.note: Cumulative supply over the first 20 years, derived from block time, block reward and halving interval.

apps.name: SWARM Wallet
apps.detail: Hold, send and receive — transparent or shielded. Windows, Linux, macOS and Android today.

apps.name: SWARM Node
apps.detail: One app runs a full node and lets you start or stop CPU mining with one click. Consent-first — nothing runs hidden.

apps.name: SWARM Explorer
apps.detail: Live for the public testnet at lwd.swarm.green:8443.

roadmap.name: Engineering testnets
roadmap.detail: Two closed networks proved the inherited proof of work, the difficulty rule, reorganisation and recovery, and end-to-end shielded payments.

roadmap.name: Public testnet
roadmap.detail: Live since 2026-09-21 with the final economic rules; wallets, mining app, Android wallet and explorer public.

roadmap.name: Mainnet engineering
roadmap.detail: Distinct production identity (genesis, magic, address prefix), replay isolation, custody tooling, separate production hosts.

roadmap.name: Independent review and soak
roadmap.detail: External review of the changes on top of upstream Zcash software, then weeks of the launch candidate under normal and failure workloads.

roadmap.name: Launch ceremony
roadmap.detail: Offline keys, genesis from a public unpredictable input, signed releases, published launch manifest.

roadmap.name: Mainnet
roadmap.detail: Block 1 mined in public. No sale, no airdrop, no conversion of test coins. No date until the gates pass.
